target_boundary: The Backend Type Test Engine Define package and accepted DEC-BTE-FORMATION-AUTHORITY-001, from the current-v1 JSON/YAML conflict through the Invoke Design handoff. Source implementation, machine admission, Plan, Task Session, UI, and consumer execution are outside this x-ray.

reader_contract.target_public: A reader who knows DomainSpec is a specification system but needs a plain explanation of what Option 2 changed, what stayed frozen, and why Design is the next safe step.
assumed_knowledge: A versioned contract can replace an older contract without rewriting its history.
A passing test proves only the checks it actually executed.
reader_contract.reader_reward: The reader can explain the two-version strategy, the exact migration and proof gates, the current false-green risk, and the difference between a human design decision and admitted machine authority.

must_start_with: what has to happen before implementation can count
must_not_start_with: a claim that YAML is already live authority
opening_contract.failure_message: Start with the practical consequence: Option 2 chooses a new versioned replacement, while current v1 remains frozen and unproven for full formation conformance.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: The machine-checkable rules that decide whether a node body really matches its declared kind.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: The present system names JSON rules in current v1 but executes YAML checks, so a pass can omit a declared rule.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: The decision selects a future owner; it does not make the current YAML adapter authoritative.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: The existing four-kind minted-project profile with its current declarations and historical behavior.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It must stay frozen so the replacement does not silently rewrite compatibility history.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Frozen does not mean complete: its compiler path still cannot claim full formation conformance.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A new profile and formation-contract version that can use YAML as its rule owner without pretending current v1 already did.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It creates a clean authority boundary and makes migration observable.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: A design document alone does not create or admit the replacement.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: An exact accounting of every old JSON constraint and where it goes in the replacement.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: Without it, a missing rule can disappear while the migration still reports success.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: A prose statement that JSON is retired is not an acceptable map.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A pass that looks valid but skipped or bypassed a governing contract.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: The known Entity body can pass the YAML adapter while violating the profile-declared JSON schema.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: The existing 147/147 and 107/107 regression baselines do not close this gap.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: The owner-controlled act that makes a particular profile and contract version valid for use.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It is the boundary between an accepted design direction and live DomainSpec behavior.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: A decision record, generated graph, receipt, or HTML page cannot self-admit a profile.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: The literal table or section shape a kind must provide before its detailed criteria can be trusted.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: The current kernel loads it but does not yet evaluate it across all 13 backend schemas.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Executing named criteria without required structure is not exact formation proof.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: Checking the identities of every required item, rather than comparing only totals.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: Completeness requires the specified obligations, generated obligations, tests, executions, and killed mutations to be the same nonempty set.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Equal counts can still hide missing, extra, duplicated, stale, skipped, or surviving items.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a working reader, I want the decision reduced to one practical contrast.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Current v1 remains frozen while a separate YAML-owned replacement is designed and proved.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: avoiding the mistaken belief that choosing Option 2 already changed runtime authority.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As an implementer, I want to see the order of work forced by Option 2.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Design comes before machine contracts, migration, false-green rejection, admission, exact-16 execution, and the later graph-to-receipt chain.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: preventing a Task Session from starting from an unmaterialized decision.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As an architect, I want to see which BTE parts depend on the replacement contract.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Profile identity, retirement mapping, YAML rule strengthening, compiler selection, fixtures, receipts, and replay must agree before proof can pass.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: seeing where a stale digest or omitted constraint would break causality.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As an owner, I want to separate BTE work from decisions and consumers outside its boundary.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Profile admission and later relationship decisions are external gates, while IOLM and Body War consume only a green core receipt.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: keeping governance and consumer proof from becoming self-certification.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a reviewer, I want every remaining reason for a false completeness claim visible.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: GAP-029 remains open for proof, GAP-030 remains open for exact criterion execution, and several formation details still need stronger machine contracts.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: distinguishing Design readiness from implementation or completeness readiness.

evidence: DEC-BTE-FORMATION-AUTHORITY-001 accepted Option 2 and unblocks Invoke Design.
The decision explicitly does not authorize source implementation, JSON retirement, machine admission, or release promotion.
Current v1 remains frozen under its existing declarations until a replacement is admitted.
inference: A two-rail visual is the smallest honest explanation: current v1 remains on one rail while the replacement advances on another.

evidence: D_kind is 13 active backend kinds, D_form is 16 kind-scoped criteria, and D_rel is 16 planning families pending admission.
The replacement must have a distinct profile/contract version and distinguish old and new identities, digests, violations, receipts, and replay results.
Markdown, this x-ray, generated views, and receipts are not semantic formation authority.
inference: Version identity and digest continuity are the load-bearing properties because they make silent in-place replacement detectable.

evidence: Current side: current-v1 profile, four JSON formation schemas, YAML criteria, shared kernel, minted-body adapter, and compiler.
Replacement side: new profile version, YAML formation contracts, JSON retirement map, compatibility/migration corpus, compiler selection, evidence receipts, and replay.
Later proof side: exact 16 criterion catalogue, canonical graph, obligations, tests, bindings, evaluators, executions, mutations, and aggregates.
inference: The retirement map should be treated as its own component rather than hidden inside profile prose.

evidence: Design must define machine contracts before Plan can expose an implementation SWU.
JSON retirement depends on constraint mapping, migrated fixture outcomes, false-green rejection, and distinguishable evidence.
Exact-16 compiler parity depends on the replacement contract design.
Graph-to-receipt proof depends on exact compiler/profile identities and digests.
inference: The narrowest safe dependency spine is replacement contract -> migration proof -> admission -> exact-16 compiler proof -> graph-to-receipt proof.

evidence: The formation-contract owner selected the direction; machine profile owners still control admission.
Relationship-family admission is deferred until after Design.
DEC-GCP-001 remains local to the optional key-and-door Rule semantic fixture.
IOLM and Body War are downstream consumers that must return fresh independent receipts after a green core.
inference: These gates should be drawn outside the BTE implementation boundary because BTE cannot self-author their decisions or receipts.

evidence: Current conflict: the profile declares JSON formation schemas while the compiler validates through YAML criteria and filters body violations.
Selected path: Invoke Design -> distinct versioned machine replacement -> JSON constraint retirement map -> compatibility/migration proof -> false-green rejection -> owner admission.
After admission: exact 16 compiler executions precede graph, obligation, test, binding, evaluator, execution, mutation, receipt, replay, and consumer aggregates.
inference: The human decision is best shown as a gate between the frozen current rail and the replacement lifecycle, not as a runtime transformation.

evidence: State 1: current v1 frozen and full formation-conformance claim blocked.
State 2: Option 2 accepted and Invoke Design unblocked.
State 3: replacement and migration contracts designed.
State 4: machine contracts implemented and compatibility evidence executed.
State 5: owners validate/admit the replacement and explicitly retire mapped JSON contracts.
State 6: exact-16 and later completeness proofs may run.
inference: Any failure before admission returns the replacement to Design or implementation without changing current-v1 history.

evidence: GAP-029 remains open until the machine replacement, retirement/migration proof, false-green rejection, receipts, and replay exist.
GAP-030 remains open for positive plus discriminating-negative compiler execution of all exact 16 criteria.
Required structure is not yet evaluated across all 13 schemas.
Interface and Mapping checks are presence-only rather than closed-domain checks.
Value Object equality is substring-based rather than structurally declared.
inference: The highest-risk failure is declaring the replacement authoritative after editing a profile but before migration, false-green, and replay evidence converge.
A custom migration-parity matrix may be needed in Design because the starter x-ray library has no domain-specific old-constraint-to-new-rule shape.

evidence: L0 static HTML and inline SVG are sufficient; no remote renderer is required.
The canonical x-ray YAML library provides process-branch, dependency-boundary, lifecycle-stack, and evidence-inference-split patterns.
inference: Use four orthogonal toggle layers over one two-rail map, followed by an ordered lifecycle and a source/inference risk matrix.
